tasks.name: 创建笔记模型
创建笔记API
创建笔记前端页面

T1.implementation_approach: Define a Note model in the database with fields for title, content, and timestamps using an ORM like SQLAlchemy or Django ORM.
T1.notes: Ensure the model includes necessary validations and indexing for efficient querying.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting notes using a framework like Flask or Django REST Framework.
T2.notes: Implement authentication and authorization to secure the API.

T3.implementation_approach: Create a frontend interface using a JavaScript framework like React or Vue.js to interact with the notes API, allowing users to manage their notes.
T3.notes: Ensure the UI is responsive and user-friendly, and handle API responses and errors gracefully.
